name: B10-0277/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants from the European Commission's plan to keep European industry competitive while cutting emissions. It welcomes the plan but says it must move from strategy to action. It asks for more money for clean industry, cheaper and more stable energy, faster permits, protection from unfair foreign competition, and support for workers' skills. This is the Parliament's opinion and set of requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to act on its plan.
- **Who it affects:** Energy-intensive industry, clean tech firms, workers and households paying energy bills.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is urged to turn the plan into concrete laws and funding.
